title: In-season week (fallback template)
author: Grok Bot
notes: In-season: rugby Thu 7–8:30pm, match Sat 2pm. Leave 1–2 reps in the tank on every lift; no grinders after Wednesday. targetKg is blank until we know your working weights – log what you lift and the plan will be updated from your logs. Week of 9 Nov: targets set from last week's logs. Knee and chest are still sore from Saturday, so no load increases yet. If the knee swells, locks or gives way, or chest pain persists or hurts when breathing, get assessed before training or playing.

days.title: Lower strength
days.notes: Warm up 10 min (bike or skipping + hip mobility). If legs are still smashed from Saturday, drop one set from each lift.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.notes: Hold at 70 while the knee settles.

exercises.name: Dumbbell walking lunge
exercises.notes: Only if the knee is comfortable; otherwise bodyweight or skip.

days.title: Easy run or ride
days.focus: Easy 30–40 min run, walk or bike
days.notes: Easy pace, around HR 120s. Skip strides if the knee is sore. 6 × 15s strides only if the knee is happy. Keep it easy – this is recovery plus engine building.

exercises.name: Easy run, walk or bike
exercises.notes: Easy pace, around HR 120s. Skip strides if the knee is sore.

days.title: Upper strength
days.notes: Keep it crisp – Thursday is training.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.notes: Keep it light and pain-free while the chest is sore; don't jump back to 70.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.notes: Leave kg blank for bodyweight; add load if 8 is easy

days.title: Rugby training
days.notes: Log feel, RPE and any scrum/contact notes. Subject to how the knee and chest feel.

days.title: Rest / mobility
days.notes: Hips, ankles, thoracic spine, neck. Hydrate and eat well before the match.

days.title: Match
days.notes: Log minutes played, scrum count/feel and any knocks. Subject to how the knee and chest feel.

days.title: Recovery ride or walk
days.notes: Easy spin or walk, then 10 min stretching. Note any niggles from the match.
